canonical_api.output_contract: out_maze is reset to NULL before validation and receives caller ownership only on success

algorithm.vertices: odd-coordinate logical cells mapped to flat IDs 0..V-1
algorithm.edges: every unique east and south logical-grid adjacency
algorithm.randomization: the Stage 1 edge insertion order and shared PCG32 Fisher-Yates shuffle are preserved
algorithm.disjoint_set: flat iterative path compression with union-by-size
algorithm.early_stop: edge consideration stops immediately after V-1 successful unions
algorithm.claim_boundary: randomized edge ordering; no minimum-weight or uniform-spanning-tree guarantee

validation.dimensions: width and height are odd and at least 3
validation.bounds: the inclusive last coordinate and each dimension must fit int32_t
validation.max_steps: one step per considered shuffled edge; default is raster cells times 8
validation.edge_count: E must fit the bounded RNG uint32_t domain
validation.cancellation: polled before generation, throughout shuffle and raster materialization, and before every considered edge
validation.exception_barrier: bad_alloc maps to OUT_OF_MEMORY; callback exceptions map to CALLBACK_FAILED; other exceptions map to CORRUPT_STATE
validation.failure_atomicity: partial Maze output is never published

compatibility.legacy_policy: deprecated ABI 1.x adapter forwarding to the checked generator
compatibility.generic_dispatcher: BYUL_MAZE_ALGORITHM_RANDOMIZED_KRUSKAL produces the same raster for equal options

wrapper.policy_tests: 10/10 maze wrapper policy tests passed against the current MSVC Release DLL
wrapper.generation_check: generated CFFI declarations are up to date

verification.sdk_consumer: clean-install C17 and C++17 consumers built and ran successfully
verification.standalone_header: clean-install MSVC C17 and C++17 probes passed
verification.strict_header_audit: 150 headers, 95 public C headers, 1170 declarations, 0 invariant errors
